children.value: > Fact From Story: The government has argued that Google uses its platforms and deals with partners to block out any competition in search or advertising, thus hindering competitors from accessing the data they’d need to improve their products.
> > Fact From Story: Google pays big bucks to be everywhere so that it can take in all the data and be the best search engine across different companies’ devices, said Pichai, according to The Verge.
> > > Fact From Story: Google has had its deal with Apple in place since 2003.
> > > Fact From Story: Google spent $26.3 billion in 2021 making itself the default search engine across platforms.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Default search engines are used more often than other search engines.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Companies pay to be the default option because it gives them an advantage over competitors.
> Fact From Story: The lawsuit stems from a 2020 antitrust claim over Google’s dominance in the online search market.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Antitrust laws are designed to prevent monopolies and promote competition in markets.
